title: New Model, Old Habits: Behavior Transfer under Model Swapping in Multi-Session LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost. Such switches require transferring a history for continuity, yet their effects on the recipient remain underexplored. Through controlled experiments with multi-session tasks, we uncover behavior transfer: recipients tend to adopt reasoning and action patterns from the models that generated their histories. This effect is most evident with raw-history transfer but is substantially reduced by summarization. Based on these findings, we propose Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History (DASH) that preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong transfer via summarization. Experiments with repeated swaps show that DASH outperforms raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines. translated_title: 新模型，旧习惯：多会话LLM智能体中模型切换下的行为迁移
translated_abstract: 多会话智能体可以在不同LLM之间切换，以平衡性能与推理成本。这种切换需要传递历史记录以保持会话连续性，但其对接收方模型的影响仍未被充分探索。通过多会话任务的受控实验，我们揭示了“行为迁移”现象：接收方模型倾向于采纳生成其历史记录的模型的推理和行动模式。这种效应在传递原始历史时最为明显，而通过摘要可以显著减弱。基于这些发现，我们提出了方向与作者感知的历史摘要方法（DASH），通过摘要保留更强模型的行为，同时最小化弱模型向强模型的行为迁移。在重复模型切换的实验中，DASH的表现优于原始历史传递和朴素摘要基线。这些结果表明，有效的多模型编排不仅需要考虑使用哪个模型，还需要考虑其行为模式如何被传递。
tldr: 揭示了多会话LLM智能体在模型切换中存在的“行为迁移”现象，并提出DASH方法，通过方向与作者感知的历史摘要保留强模型行为、抑制弱到强的行为迁移，显著优于原始历史传递和朴素摘要基线。
en_tdlr: DASH (Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History) preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong behavior transfer during model swapping in multi-session LLM agents, outperforming raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines.
